summary: This is a Mol Labs public research discussion card (P29) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether orexin-A retains arousal, cognition, or neuroprotection phenotypes (≥50% of control) under conditions where OX1R-class attribution is abolished (via SB-334867 antagonist or Hcrtr1/OX1R genetic LOF). The document synthesizes prior literature (Hagan, Zhao, Smart, Mieda, Liu) and concludes that matched residual-positive orexin-A data under OX1R-abolish on the relevant panels is currently EMPTY/UNKNOWN — no experiment has been run. The project is at TRL 1–2: a well-framed hypothesis with supporting prior art but no executed experiment.

content_blocks.title: Document Overview and Claim
content_blocks.content: Mol Labs public report (P29). The central claim is: on a matched rodent arousal/cognition/neuroprotection panel (Hagan-class arousal, Zhao-class PTZ spatial learning/memory, or Liu-class MPTP neuroprotection) ± orexin-A ± OX1R antagonist (SB-334867) or Hcrtr1/OX1R genetic LOF titrated to abolish OX1R-class attribution, residual orexin-A arousal/cognitive/neuroprotective phenotype remains ≥50% of the orexin-A without-OX1R-abolish arm. This is framed as an 'assumption-kill' (ox1r-insufficiency) experiment. Execution status: NOT_RUN. The matched residual-positive H2H data is EMPTY/UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Scientific Rationale
content_blocks.content: Hagan maps orexin-A LC firing + behavioral arousal. Zhao maps orexin-A spatial learning/memory rescue via OX1R-linked hippocampal neurogenesis (SB334867 attenuates — necessity-leaning). Smart maps SB-334867-A as selective OX1R antagonist tool. Mieda maps ICV orexin-A in OX1R(-/-) vs OX2R(-/-) sleep/wake (attenuated; OX2R-dominant). Liu maps orexin-A MPTP neuroprotection blocked by SB334867 (necessity). The question is whether residual orexin-A arousal/cognition/neuroprotection under OX1R abolish still requires a path beyond OX1R-class attribution.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary — Hagan 1999 (PMID 10485925)
content_blocks.content: Assay: Rat; orexinergic LC innervation mapping; orexin-A application to LC; electrophysiology of noradrenergic neurones; behavioral arousal/locomotor activity. Result: Orexin-A increased LC noradrenergic cell firing; increased arousal and locomotor activity; densest orexinergic innervation to LC. Classification: Arousal phenotype PRIOR (WT OX1R present; no Hcrtr1 LOF / SB-334867 residual arm). DOI: 10.1073/pnas.96.19.10911.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary — Zhao 2014 (PMID 24321199)
content_blocks.content: Assay: PTZ-kindled rats; orexin-A; Morris water maze; i.c.v. OX1R antagonist SB334867; ERK1/2 inhibitor U0126; BrdU/DCX/NeuN dentate neurogenesis markers. Result: Orexin-A improved spatial learning/memory and increased dentate neurogenesis markers in PTZ-kindled rats; effects attenuated/inhibited by SB334867 or U0126. Classification: Cognition phenotype PRIOR with NECESSITY-leaning AGAINST residual — SB334867 attenuates the rescue, meaning OX1R is necessary. Explicitly NOT to be misread as residual-positive under OX1R abolish. DOI: 10.1016/j.peptides.2013.11.019.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary — Smart 2001 (PMID 11250867)
content_blocks.content: Assay: CHO cells stably expressing human OX1 or OX2; Fluo-3AM Ca2+ assay; orexin-A/B; SB-334867-A. Result: SB-334867-A inhibited orexin-A/B-induced Ca2+ in CHO-OX1; no agonist activity; weak OX2 inhibition at 10 µM. Classification: Selective OX1R antagonist TOOL prior — not a residual H2H experiment. DOI: 10.1038/sj.bjp.0703953.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary — Mieda 2011 (PMID 21525292)
content_blocks.content: Assay: Wild-type, OX1R(-/-), and OX2R(-/-) mice; ICV orexin-A; sleep/wake EEG (wakefulness, NREM, REM). Result: ICV orexin-A wakefulness/NREM effects significantly attenuated in both OX1R(-/-) and OX2R(-/-) vs WT, with substantially larger attenuation in OX2R(-/-) than OX1R(-/-). Classification: Drug-in-KO FOUND; necessity-leaning attenuation; OX2R-dominant; partial residual under OX1R-only KO reflects OX2R bridge — NOT clean residual-positive cognition/NP. Document OX2R co-receptor honesty; do not auto-clone to OX2R residual claim. DOI: 10.1523/JNEUROSCI.6506-10.2011.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary — Liu (PMID 30524223, Promoted)
content_blocks.content: Assay: MPTP Parkinson's disease mouse model; orexin-A neuroprotection and spatial memory; SB334867 OX1R antagonist. Result: Orexin-A neuroprotection and spatial memory improvement in MPTP mice blocked by SB334867. Classification: NECESSITY AGAINST residual for that NP/cognition panel. Promoted (out of public prior_art ≤4). This is necessity evidence, not residual-positive evidence.

content_blocks.title: Key Prediction Variables and Experimental Design
content_blocks.content: Primary prediction variable: 'residual_orexinA_arousal_cognition_NP_ge50pct_of_orexinA_without_OX1R_abolish' — PREDICTION (not yet run). Design: Pre-registered matched rodent arousal/cognition/neuroprotection panel (Hagan-class arousal, Zhao-class PTZ spatial learning/memory, or Liu-class MPTP NP style) ± orexin-A ± OX1R antagonist (SB-334867) or Hcrtr1/OX1R genetic LOF. OX1R-abolish condition must first abolish OX1R-class attribution, then score residual orexin-A phenotype vs orexin-A without-OX1R-abolish arm. Threshold: residual ≥50% of orexin-A without-OX1R-abolish arm. Preferred sequence: cell/slice/block-QC (SB-334867 or Hcrtr1 ablation) before new animal panels; in vivo panel remains primary kill path; include OX2R-control arm for honesty. Secondary prediction: competing outcomes (abolish-fail, agonist-alone-null, underpowered strata, assay-mismatch, OX2R-confound) classified as inconclusive rather than refuted.

content_blocks.title: Current Evidence Status and Gap
content_blocks.content: Matched residual-positive orexin-A arousal/cognition/neuroprotection under SB-334867/Hcrtr1 LOF that abolishes OX1R-class attribution on Hagan/Zhao/Liu-style panels: EMPTY/UNKNOWN. Soft-complete scores: Q_resid_tight NON-MATCH (residual-positive not found); Q_resid inflated; Q_necess AGAINST (Zhao/Liu); Q_P23_tight NON-MATCH (OX1R≠OXTR); Q_P28–P24_tight NON-MATCH; Q_FOXO4/Q_BPC NON-MATCH. Execution status: NOT_RUN. FTO status: UNKNOWN. Soft-complete empty ≠ novelty / ≠ failure.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered matched rodent panel ± orexin-A ± OX1R antagonist (SB-334867) or Hcrtr1/OX1R genetic LOF where OX1R-abolish abolishes OX1R-class attribution, residual orexin-A arousal/cognitive/neuroprotective phenotype is <50% of the orexin-A without-OX1R-abolish arm — so OX1R-class-attribution framing survives and ox1r-insufficiency residual fails — when abolish-fail, agonist-alone-null, underpowered strata, assay-mismatch, or OX2R-confound artifacts are ruled out.

key_findings: Execution status is NOT_RUN — no experiment has been performed; the matched residual-positive orexin-A H2H under OX1R-abolish is EMPTY/UNKNOWN.
Hagan (PMID 10485925): Orexin-A increases LC noradrenergic firing and behavioral arousal in rats — arousal phenotype PRIOR, but no OX1R-abolish residual arm exists.
Zhao (PMID 24321199): SB334867 (OX1R antagonist) attenuates orexin-A rescue of spatial learning/memory in PTZ-kindled rats — NECESSITY-leaning AGAINST residual-positive interpretation.
Smart (PMID 11250867): SB-334867-A is a selective OX1R antagonist tool (CHO-OX1 Ca2+ assay; weak OX2 at 10 µM) — tool prior only, not a residual H2H.

Mieda (PMID 21525292): ICV orexin-A wakefulness/NREM effects attenuated in OX1R(-/-) and OX2R(-/-) mice, with substantially larger attenuation in OX2R(-/-) — OX2R-dominant; partial residual under OX1R-only KO reflects OX2R bridge, not clean residual-positive cognition/NP.
Liu (PMID 30524223): Orexin-A neuroprotection and spatial memory in MPTP mice blocked by SB334867 — NECESSITY AGAINST residual for that NP/cognition panel.
The central hypothesis (residual orexin-A ≥50% of control under OX1R-abolish) is a PREDICTION only; prior art provides necessity evidence against residual, not for it.
OX2R co-receptor honesty required: Mieda data shows OX2R bridge under OX1R-only abolish; do not auto-clone OX2R residual as OX1R residual.
